_doc: rows: fallback stats per weapon class, used only for a value the player's items_game.txt (prep -> cs2/weapon_stats.json, plus the raw cs2/scripts/items/items_game.txt for keys prep does not list) does not give. Every value is unverified and loses to the real file. mechanics: the constants of the gun model around those stats (recoil punch, spread, penetration, armor, knife, scope, reload, viewmodel kicks). Most are CS:GO SDK defaults that CS2 may have changed, so each says so. reference: a few stats every CS2 player knows; --wtest stats_reference compares each against the value resolved from the player's files (only where the files gave one), so a CS2 update that moved or renamed a stat key shows up as a FAIL instead of a silent class average.
